description: This file contains CMake functions for creating and registering new event objects within a project. It defines two implementations of an 'event_new' function to create event objects with properties such as event_id, handlers, and functions for adding, removing, and clearing handlers. The functions also register the events globally in a map 'events'.

methods.name: event_new
methods.description: Creates a new event object with properties such as event_id and handler management functions. It registers the event globally in the 'events' map and provides both a curry-based and a direct implementation.
